faq: Do I need to be sending already?
No. If you are starting from nothing, we plan a gentle rhythm that fits your list size. If you already send, we use your past results to place the best days and topics.
How many emails should I send each week?

It depends on your list, products and how people respond. We usually suggest a rhythm you can keep up, such as one to two emails a week, and show how to adjust it using your open and unsubscribe numbers.
Does the calendar include the written emails?
It includes a brief for each send: the subject idea, main message and offer. The finished copy and design are separate services, and you can order them with this one.
Will it work for seasonal businesses?
Yes. We build around your busy and quiet periods, and plan warm-up sends before peak weeks. Tell us when your year gets busy in the order form.
